charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1101_0100:
As [Name:PlayerNickname ] was walking
through the town square, [EN:Gen Ref="255" M="he" F="she" ] spotted Serena
being interviewed in the middle of a crowd.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_0200:
Oh, [Name:PlayerNickname ]! What a
coincidence! I wasn’t expecting to meet you
here!
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_0300:
I was just being interviewed about street
fashion.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_0400:
Looks like our style caught some attention!
Isn’t that great?!
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_0600:
A lot comes to mind when I’m next to Mega
Greninja like this.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_0700:
This little one has been with me ever since I
was in Kalos. He’s my precious partner.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_0800:
We’ve shared all sorts of emotions and
countless battles during our travels.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_0900:
That’s why I take pride in my bond with
Greninja and Mega Evolving him.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_0401_1100: Really? Thanks! He’s the perfect partner!
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_0302_1200: I can’t wait to see how he’ll battle!
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_0402_1300:
*giggle* You must be curious. We make the
strongest partners.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_1400:
I was a little worried I wouldn’t be able to
properly guide such power.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_1500:
But Greninja, who once fought while hiding
himself like a shadow...
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_1700: I’m sure this is a reflection of his resolve.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_1800:
I can’t afford to waver when my Pokémon
is steeling his resolve this much.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_1900:
I have to do my part by living up to
Greninja’s determination!
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_0301_2000: I’m sure you can do it, Serena.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_0401_2100:
*giggle* Thanks! Hearing you say that gives
me a bit more confidence.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_0402_2300:
*giggle* Thanks! With your support, we can
get even stronger.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_2400:
Oh, right! A special event tied to the fashion
show will be held in the town square soon.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_2500:
It’s a Pokémon battle based on a
performance. We’ve decided to enter.
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_2600:
I hope you come along too,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].
charaepi_ch0130_41_serena/2301_1201_2700:
I’ll give you a full view of my teamwork
with Greninja!
